note: Issue framing only. #30280 and #80036 report that MCP tools are not reliably inherited by subagents. That is one visible consequence, not the whole of it — the behaviour is not MCP-specific and reproduces with zero MCP servers configured. Framing it as MCP inheritance hides the inverse: a child from a well-stocked parent silently gains tools its definition excludes. Server-side authorization still refused cross-role writes in the reporter's setup, so it was contained for them — but the containment is theirs, not the harness's. Any project relying on tools: alone has none. No user-facing harness workaround is stated.
